Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 5), the Planner incorrectly compared the two birth dates. It stated, "Conclusion: Gideon Johnson Pillow was born later than Holm Jølsen," but this is logically false. Gideon Johnson Pillow was born in 1806, and Holm Jølsen was born in 1833. Since 1833 is later than 1806, Holm Jølsen was born later. The Planner failed to perform the basic numerical comparison of the years it had successfully retrieved from the sources.
